notes.title: First major update! Oculus headsets now supported.
notes.content:
So what's new, why the long wait?

All Oculus Headsets now supported, Including Quest and Quest 2 with Link.
Profile support and weapon grip angle customization included. 
Lots of stability and performance improvements. 
LIV Mixed reality capture support
Interactive and video tutorials to help walk new users through how to move, shoot, and change Maps.

The largest reason for the wait is still in the works, but the foundation is in place, and we have a lot more to come soon.

notes.title: 1st Game update just went live!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work since Tactical AR came out. Here's a summary of what went into the new release

Top shot elite (PS3) controller support for rifle and pistol

Rifle support for vive controllers (used to only support pistol) (( we strongly suggest a 3d printed stock on your controller for rifle))

VRMoveME locomotion updated, alpha support for locomotion with trackers mounted to track straps

New 3 gun course added.

Bugs fixed.

Next in pipe:
add user configurable offsets for weapons and grip angles.
